inspected: Full-page PNG at 4200 x 2970 and Inkscape renders of the master SVG at 130 to 260 dpi
Detail views: fine gold fittings, bands and maker plate, rear wheel and rear scraper, forward scraper, flywheel, front roll, boiler and cylinder, top-right badges
Retained actual-engine colour photographs by Benjamin Matthews and Terry Pinnegar, including the red-brown rear scraper
observations: White paper with every revision-14 outline in black, apart from the thin inner lines of the three boiler bands, drawn in gold; engine linework one pen heavier and clearly darker than the colour

Black-painted iron (chimney, smokebox, headstock, firebox, fittings, controls) is hatched in black lines only, the spacing setting the tone; no grey pen is used and the overall look matches the previous grey-based edition
The bright red is darkened with the studio 0.25 mm brown pen: red and brown lines alternate 0.30 mm apart on the fork, scrapers, mounts and chain spring bar
Rear scraper bracket, boss, arm and blade in red-brown (red lines with brown between); the space between the scraper arm and spring rod is green tender
Forward scraper mounts and arm in red-brown against the black iron
Wheels, hubs and flywheel read as black iron in close, even circles
Through the rear wheel, a black hatch lighter than the wheel rims up to the tender front edge and above its top rim; green tender beyond the edge
Every spoke ruled with the same number of even, parallel lines; front roll interior paper
Worksplate and Invicta horse at top right without colour
Boiler bands read as solid gold bars from one black edge to the other: five upright gold lines about 0.42 mm apart, the band's own inner line one of them; no white strip remains down either side
The safety valves, whistle, lubricator and maker plate are several fine gold lines 0.50 mm apart; no broad gold nib is used
Every band is gold from end to end; the band nearest the flywheel runs up to the motion plate
Open air under the regulator rod on both sides of the flywheel, and between the lubricator pedestal and its pipe, is white paper
The boiler barrel between the motion plate and the pump rod beside the flywheel is green
Every visible spoke of both rolls is coloured, including the sliver of the front roll's top-right far spoke beside the fork
One-page A3 PDF with no clipping or lettering collisions
scope: Visual and vector review of a photograph-based interpretive pen illustration. The palette uses available studio inks, not measured paint matching. No physical plot was run.
